column1: # kb-golden.tsv — the regression gate for the knowledge base.
# Every row is a real (name, brand) pair from the production catalogue, and
# every expectation was reviewed by hand against the seeded knowledge base. It
# is asserted by test/scrape/kb-golden.integration.spec.ts, which is what any
# later change to the seed, the resolver or the prompts has to survive.
# An empty `producer` is a deliberate expectation, not a gap: an undisclosed
# label must never be guessed, and a producer the auto-gate withheld is
# invisible to the resolver until a reviewer promotes it. Both are recorded
# here so that a change which starts resolving them shows up as a diff to read
